leg: shift-bound prediction of the optimal alpha

predeclared.hypotheses: H1: C_implied = s(alpha_opt) is level independent; H2: C calibrated on one dx predicts alpha at the others; H5: A_implied = N_steps*s(alpha_opt) is level independent and transfers (declared after dx=0.04/0.03/0.02, before dx=0.01); H6: the per-level alpha indifference intervals (tol = 1.0 pp / 15 % rel) share a common alpha, i.e. the data do not resolve a resolution-dependent optimum
